record.paper_title: Recent advances and open questions on the susy structure of the chiral de Rham Complex
record.original_question: Are the copies of the Shatashvili-Vafa G2 superconformal algebra SV^G2 embedded in the smooth chiral de Rham complex of a G2-holonomy manifold by Rodriguez's theorem simple vertex algebras, so that the Virasoro subalgebra generated by X is the unitary c=7/10 minimal model and the proposed G2 topological twist can be applied?

evidence.quote: The above discussion is only possible if the V ir7/10 generated by X is simple, that is, is a member of the minimal series.
4.21 Question. Are the algebras SV G2 ⊂ ΩchM produced by Rodriguez theorem simple vertex algebras?

The question above, in case of the affirmative, would be an analog to Song's claim in the N = 4 case of the K3 surface. It will also provide a unitary V ir7/10 subalgebra generated by X and hence we can apply the program of [14] to perform the topological twist.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let M be a smooth Riemannian manifold of dimension 7 with holonomy group equal to the exceptional group G2, and let Ω^{ch}_M denote its smooth chiral de Rham complex, viewed as a sheaf of N=1 superconformal vertex algebras on M. The Shatashvili–Vafa G2 superconformal vertex algebra SV^{G2} is the W-algebra extension of the N=1 superconformal algebra at central charge c = 21/2 generated by fields {L, G, Φ, K, X, M} satisfying the Shatashvili–Vafa OPE relations; in particular it contains a Virasoro field X of central charge c = 7/10 commuting with the remaining N=1 super-Virasoro structure. By a theorem of Rodriguez (here referred to as the "Rodriguez embedding"), the vertex algebra of global sections of Ω^{ch}_M contains two commuting copies of SV^{G2}.

Question. For each of the two copies of SV^{G2} produced by the Rodriguez embedding inside the global sections of Ω^{ch}_M, is the embedded copy a simple vertex algebra? Equivalently, do the embedded copies coincide with the simple quotient of the universal Shatashvili–Vafa vertex algebra at c = 21/2, so that the c = 7/10 Virasoro subalgebra generated by the field X is the unitary tricritical Ising minimal model (a member of the unitary discrete series of Virasoro minimal models)?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surface continuing research on Shatashvili–Vafa G2 algebras, their embeddings into the chiral de Rham complex on G2 manifolds (Rodriguez/Ekstrand–Heluani–Källén–Zabzine), deformations and quantum Hamiltonian reductions, but no source explicitly establishes (or refutes) that the specific copies of SV^{G2} produced by Rodriguez's embedding inside Ω^{ch}_M are simple vertex algebras with the c = 7/10 piece being the unitary tricritical Ising minimal model. The simplicity question and its consequence for performing the proposed G2 topological twist appear to remain unresolved in the publicly available literature.

status_evidence.title: G2 Holonomy Manifolds are Superconformal
status_evidence.snippet: The vertex algebra of global sections of the chiral de Rham complex associated to a manifold M with holonomy G2 contains two commuting copies of the Shatashvili-Vafa G2 superconformal algebra.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the Rodriguez-type embedding but does not address simplicity of the embedded copies.

status_evidence.title: G2-structures with torsion and the deformed Shatashvili–Vafa vertex algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Representations of the deformed Shatashvili–Vafa vertex algebra SV_a were constructed and embedded in the chiral de Rham complex for integrable G2-structures with closed torsion.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work extends the embedding but does not settle whether the embedded SV^{G2} copies are simple vertex algebras.

status_evidence.title: The Shatashvili-Vafa G2 superconformal algebra as a quantum Hamiltonian reduction of D(2,1;α)
status_evidence.snippet: Realises SV^{G2} as a quantum Hamiltonian reduction of D(2,1;α) at α=1.
status_evidence.claim: Provides structural information about SV^{G2} but does not resolve simplicity of the Rodriguez-embedded copies inside the chiral de Rham complex.
